package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const (
	SubjectDialogTeacherContextMutated       = "dialog.teacher.context-mutated"
	DialogTeacherContextMutatedSchemaVersion = 1
)

type DialogTeacherContextMutationKind string

const (
	DialogTeacherContextMutationUpdated DialogTeacherContextMutationKind = "updated"
	DialogTeacherContextMutationDeleted DialogTeacherContextMutationKind = "deleted"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidDialogTeacherContextMutation  = errors.New("invalid dialog teacher context mutation")
	ErrDialogTeacherContextMutationConflict = errors.New("dialog teacher context mutation conflict")
)

// DialogTeacherContextMutation is a body-free Dialog-owned invalidation fact.
// It contains identity and ordering only; no message content is accepted.
type DialogTeacherContextMutation struct {
	SchemaVersion     int
	EventID           string
	EventType         string
	OccurredAt        time.Time
	DialogID          string
	EventSequence     int64
	StudentID         string
	PersonalTeacherID string
	ContextType       LearningContextType
	ContextID         string
	MessageID         string
	MessageSequence   int64
	MessageVersion    int
	LastEventSequence int64
	Mutation          DialogTeacherContextMutationKind
}

func NewDialogTeacherContextMutation(input DialogTeacherContextMutation) (DialogTeacherContextMutation, error) {
	input.EventID = strings.TrimSpace(input.EventID)
	input.EventType = strings.TrimSpace(input.EventType)
	input.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.PersonalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PersonalTeacherID)
	input.ContextID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ContextID)
	input.MessageID = strings.TrimSpace(input.MessageID)
	input.Mutation = DialogTeacherContextMutationKind(strings.TrimSpace(string(input.Mutation)))
	input.OccurredAt = input.OccurredAt.UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)
	if input.SchemaVersion != DialogTeacherContextMutatedSchemaVersion || input.EventType != SubjectDialogTeacherContextMutated ||
		!validUUID(input.EventID) || !validUUID(input.DialogID) || !validUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		!validUUID(input.PersonalTeacherID) || !validUUID(input.MessageID) ||
		!validTeacherDialogBindingContext(input.ContextType, input.ContextID) || input.OccurredAt.IsZero() ||
		input.EventSequence < 1 || input.MessageSequence < 1 || input.MessageVersion < 1 ||
		input.LastEventSequence != input.EventSequence || input.LastEventSequence < input.MessageSequence ||
		(input.Mutation != DialogTeacherContextMutationUpdated && input.Mutation != DialogTeacherContextMutationDeleted) {
		return DialogTeacherContextMutation{}, ErrInvalidDialogTeacherContextMutation
	}
	return input, nil
}

func (input DialogTeacherContextMutation) Scope() TeacherContextScope {
	return TeacherContextScope{
		StudentID: input.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: input.PersonalTeacherID,
		DialogID: input.DialogID, ContextType: input.ContextType, ContextID: input.ContextID,
	}
}
